title: State endemic tree.
bodyText: `Ōhi`a lehua (Metrosideros polymorpha) is adopted, established, and designated as the official endemic tree of the State.
bodyHtml: [§5-8.5]  State endemic tree.  `Ōhi`a lehua (Metrosideros polymorpha) is adopted, established, and designated as the official endemic tree of the State. [L 2022, c 25, §2]
